# Navigation Examples

受控导航组件优先维护当前项、页码或展开状态，再传给组件。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## BreadcrumbItem

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/breadcrumb-item/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/breadcrumb-item/`.

Vue: `<Breadcrumb><BreadcrumbItem href="/" current>Home</BreadcrumbItem></Breadcrumb>`

React: `<Breadcrumb><BreadcrumbItem href="/" current>Home</BreadcrumbItem></Breadcrumb>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
